text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired for service `inference-rate-limiter-prod` — INC-8472. Urgency: high. Trigger: 5xx rate >10% (5m), p50 latency spike, anomalous tail. Affected: hosted-api (us-west1), Dedicated pools. Pager: Maya (oncall).
Maya (oncall): ack INC-8472. I'm taking ownership and starting triage. @Sam R can you check the model-router pods?
Sam R: on it. quick glance at prod — seeing OOM/killed on `model-router-03` and worker-group-5 restarting. Pulling logs now.
Jonas (SRE): I can spin up extra nodes if we need capacity. Any KV cache thrash or redis errors?
Maya (oncall): logs show frequent GC + OOM, 5xxs correlate with longer-context requests. Customer impact: some text-generation requests returning 5xx ~15% overall, worse for >4k tokens.
incident-bot: PagerDuty — autocheck: alerting L2 if no ack in 5m (ack now present, no escalate).
Sam R: scaling `model-router` to 8 replicas as immediate mitigation. Running:
```
kubectl -n prod scale deploy/model-router --replicas=8
kubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/model-router
```
Sam R: rolling restart on worker-group-5 to clear bad state.
OpsBot: Deployment health update: `model-router-03` restarted, new replica ready. CPU 65%, memory stable.
Sam R: p50 down a bit; p95 still elevated. I'm going to toggle fallback routing for long-context to a smaller model to reduce memory pressure.
```
# toggle route to smaller model
curl -X POST "https://console.redwood/api/v1/route-toggle" -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" -d '{"service":"inference","route":"long-context","target":"gpt-small-v2"}'
```
Sam R: route toggle applied. Monitor the error rate.
Jonas (SRE): applying temporary rate-limit for long-context requests to reduce backend queuing:
```
redwood rate-limit set --route long-context --limit 5rps --reason "emergency backpressure"
```
Maya (oncall): I've put a banner on status.redwood.com -> "Investigating: elevated errors for text-generation in us-west1" and paged the account team @account-team-bot for impacted customers.
account-team-bot: Notified account leads for affected customers (acct-42, acct-77).
Elaine D: ack. I'll be available to take over in ~25m if needed — preparing to join the incident channel.
Sam R: after scale and route changes: p50 180ms, p95 620ms, 5xx down to ~3%. Good improvement but not fully stable, still watching memory allocations in the router.
Maya (oncall): ETA next update 10m. Jon, if you can look at heap dumps from the crashed pod when you have a sec that'd help.
Jonas (SRE): grabbing heap dump now, will upload to incident doc. Thinking leak vs sudden mem spike on long-context tensors.
incident-bot: PagerDuty — note added to INC-8472 by Maya (oncall): "Scaled router, toggled fallback model, added rate-limit. Monitoring."
Maya (oncall): temporary owner handoff: @Elaine D in 20m if things stable. If not, I'll stay.
Elaine D: ack and read. Taking over after Maya's handoff. Will follow up on post-incident runbook items.
Sam R: leaving a snippet of commands I ran in the thread for postmortem:
```
kubectl -n prod scale deploy/model-router --replicas=8
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/worker-group-5
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/v1/route-toggle -d '{"route":"long-context","target":"gpt-small-v2"}'
redwood rate-limit set --route long-context --limit 5rps
```
Maya (oncall): PD note: notified engineering leads and customer success. Customer-facing comms drafted.
OpsBot: Metric summary (5m window) after mitigations — 5xx rate: 2.9% (down from 15%), p95 latency: 0.62s (down from 2.2s).
Sam R: looks stable for the moment. I'm going to leave the fallback routing and rate-limits in place for 30m while we confirm root cause.
Jonas (SRE): uploaded heap dump and pod logs to https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-8472/artifacts (see notes). Initial look suggests a memory retention in tokenizer cache under specific sequences.
Maya (oncall): handing primary to Elaine D now — Elaine you are primary.
Elaine D: ack. Taking ownership. I'll coordinate the post-incident investigation and schedule a deeper replay. Closing PD after 2 successful 5m windows.
Maya (oncall): thanks everyone. I'm standing by if Elaine needs escalation.
Elaine D: confirmed stable for 2x 5m windows. p95 and 5xx near baseline. Marking INC-8472 resolved and closing PD incident.
incident-bot: PagerDuty — INC-8472 resolved by Elaine D. Duration 48m. Follow-up: postmortem required, assign to Jonas (SRE) and Sam R for remediation and runbook updates.
Sam R: I'll open a follow-up ticket to add an automated route-fallback toggle to runbook and add better memory metrics to alerting.
Elaine D: thanks y'all :thumbsup: Will create postmortem draft and link runbook changes.
Maya (oncall): great work. Quick debrief later today 14:30 PT.
Sam R: noted.
Jonas (SRE): thanks team.
Elaine D: closing the incident channel, will post the postmortem link when ready. :white_check_mark:
